sources.title: ZelligeAI/Tessera-27B-B-CJK · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Tessera-27B-B-CJK is a coding-agent model built on Qwen3.8-27B. It thinks in compressed CJK, a shorthand that mixes English, Chinese words and symbols, and on held-out agent tasks it uses 0.50-0.64x the base model's thinking tokens per turn. Answers and tool calls stay in plain English and code.

sources.title: Tessera-27B-B-CJK: teaching a 27B agent to think less per turn
sources.snippet: Tessera-27B-B-CJK is a rank-32 LoRA on Qwen3.8-27B that thinks less per turn and still acts. On 44 frozen states from 11 coding-agent tasks that no training or selection step used, it uses about 0.50-0.64x the base model's thinking tokens per agentic turn.
